articles.title: Ethereum’s biggest protocol overhaul in years moves into its final development stage
articles.snippet: Developers are entering the final stretch of work on Glamsterdam, the network's next major upgrade, as teams begin testing a version of the fork in a closed environment.

articles.title: Rio de Janeiro Built an AI Model That Beat DeepSeek—But Was Based on Someone Else's Work
articles.snippet: Rio de Janeiro released a frontier-class AI model that claimed to beat Alibaba's best. Then Nex showed up with receipts.
